name: Comme des Garçons
founders: Rei Kawakubo. CEO Adrian Joffe is her husband; she remains the designer.
story: Her mother left her father when he would not let her work. Kawakubo left home after college, styled shoots, then designed clothes because Japanese shops did not have what she needed. The name is from Françoise Hardy’s song Tous les garçons et les filles — clothes like the boys, for women who do not dress to seduce.

Paris 1981–82 was a scandal: black, holes, unfinished seams. WWD called the 1982 Destroy collection the Hiroshima bag lady look — a critic insult, not her slogan. She has said she felt an affinity with the punk spirit: punk is against flattery, and that is what she likes about it. The 2017 Met show Art of the In-Between put her in the same museum conversation as Westwood.
style_codes: Black, asymmetry, holes, volumes that ignore the waist
Attitude: anti-fashion, start from zero — the last is a common paraphrase; the sourced line is punk against flattery

quotes.text: I’ve always felt an affinity with the punk spirit. I like that word. Every collection is that. Punk is against flattery, and that’s what I like about it.
